title: Nut-Free Tangy Normandy Penne Madeleine
description: A creamy one-pot Normandy pasta baked into madeleine-shaped portions with tangy mustard, leeks, apples and herbed cream.
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C and grease a shallow madeleine pan.
In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat and sauté sliced leeks until soft, about 5 minutes.
Add diced apple, Dijon mustard, and white wine; cook for 2 minutes, letting the wine reduce slightly.
Stir in the dry penne and pour enough water to barely cover the pasta, season with salt and pepper, and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, add heavy cream, lemon zest, and fresh thyme, and simmer until pasta is al dente and sauce thickens, about 10 minutes.
Remove skillet from heat, stir in grated parmesan until melted and creamy.
Spoon the pasta mixture into the greased madeleine pan, spreading it evenly.
Bake uncovered for 12 minutes, or until the top is lightly golden and the edges set.
Let the dish rest for 5 minutes, then carefully lift the madeleine-shaped portions onto a serving plate.
Serve hot, optionally garnished with additional thyme or lemon zest.
